evidence.reason: The recorder append is outside boot's protected region: Popen runs at 712, recorder.append at 714-715, and the try begins only at 716. If recorder.append raises, boot exits before it writes process.json and before its cleanup block can terminate the spawned process, so the QEMU child can remain live. Moving the append inside the try (or otherwise making cleanup use the spawned process even when identity persistence fails) is the smallest correctness fix.
